title: DRE profiles
description: Connections and destinations, in `profiles.yml`: what reports read from and where outputs go. Kept outside the project (`~/.dre`, `--profiles-dir` or `DRE_PROFILES_DIR`). Every profile lists its targets (environments); the run picks one for all of them: `--target`, `DRE_TARGET`, `target` in dre_project.yml, else `dev`.

connections.description: Database connections, referenced by `default_profile`, `profile:` (report, query, Set, folder `+profile`) and a source's `profile`.

sources.description: DRE 0.1's name for `connections:`. Still read in 0.2.x, with a warning: rename it to `connections:`.

profile.description: A named connection with one entry per target (environment).

targets.description: The environments of this profile, by name (e.g. `dev`, `prod`).

target.description: Ignored since DRE 0.2 (with a warning): the run picks one target for every profile.

One target of a profile: a connection or delivery configuration. `type` names the plugin; every other key is a field of that plugin (see the plugins reference), and secrets belong in `{{ env_var('NAME') }}`.

type.description: The plugin type of the connection, e.g. `duckdb`, `postgres`, `databricks`, `sftp`, `s3`. `local` needs no plugin.
